web/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx.name: Sign-in state
web/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx.description: Keeps track of whether someone is signed in, handles signing in and out and keeps them signed in.

web/src/auth/claims.ts.name: Signed-in person's role
web/src/auth/claims.ts.description: Reads the person's role and ID from their sign-in pass to decide what to show; the server still enforces who may do what.

web/src/auth/farmCodeCache.ts.name: Remembered farm codes
web/src/auth/farmCodeCache.ts.description: Cleans up and remembers the farm codes typed at sign-in so they can be offered again, with a way to remove one.

web/src/auth/oauthScopes.ts.name: Connected app permissions
web/src/auth/oauthScopes.ts.description: Lists the permissions a connected app can ask for, in the order the consent screen shows them.

web/src/auth/returnPath.ts.name: Return after sign-in
web/src/auth/returnPath.ts.description: Works out where to send someone after sign-in, only ever to a screen in this app.

web/src/auth/sessionSignal.ts.name: Tab sign-in alert
web/src/auth/sessionSignal.ts.description: Tells the other open tabs when someone signs in or out here, so a tab showing unsaved recovery codes hides them.

web/src/auth/tokenStore.ts.name: Sign-in pass keeper
web/src/auth/tokenStore.ts.description: Holds the sign-in pass in the page's memory only, never in saved browser storage, and remembers which account and farm it belongs to.

web/src/auth/useAuth.ts.name: Sign-in access helper
web/src/auth/useAuth.ts.description: Gives any screen access to the current sign-in state, and fails if used outside the sign-in wrapper.

web/src/routes/Login.tsx.name: Sign-in screen
web/src/routes/Login.tsx.description: Takes the farm code, username and password, hands over to the second step when needed and returns to where the person was going.

web/src/routes/ProtectedRoute.tsx.name: Sign-in gate
web/src/routes/ProtectedRoute.tsx.description: Sends signed-out visitors to sign in, and sends people who must set a new password or two-step sign-in to those screens first.

web/src/routes/SecondFactorStep.tsx.name: Second sign-in step
web/src/routes/SecondFactorStep.tsx.description: Asks for the second code during sign-in and finishes the sign-in when it is right.

web/src/routes/SetPasswordPage.tsx.name: New password screen
web/src/routes/SetPasswordPage.tsx.description: Makes someone choose a new password the first time they sign in before they can use the app.

web/src/routes/signInMessage.ts.name: Sign-in error messages
web/src/routes/signInMessage.ts.description: Turns a failed sign-in into a message in the person's language.

web/src/routes/TwoFactorDeadlineBanner.t.name: Two-step deadline banner
web/src/routes/TwoFactorDeadlineBanner.t.description: Reminds owners to set up two-step sign-in by a deadline while it is still off.

web/src/routes/TwoFactorEnrolmentPage.ts.name: Two-step setup screen
web/src/routes/TwoFactorEnrolmentPage.ts.description: Takes over for an owner who is past the deadline until two-step sign-in is set up.

web/src/session/LanguageSelector.tsx.name: Language picker
web/src/session/LanguageSelector.tsx.description: Lets each person choose the language of the screens, saved to their own account.

web/src/session/SessionContext.tsx.name: Signed-in person's details
web/src/session/SessionContext.tsx.description: Loads who is signed in, their farm and language right after sign-in and shares it with every screen.

web/src/session/StepperUnitSelector.tsx.name: Entry unit picker
web/src/session/StepperUnitSelector.tsx.description: Lets each person choose the pack unit used by the plus and minus buttons on daily entry, on the Account screen.
